evaluation_timestamp_basis: stamped at end of analysis, within ~1 min of file serialisation (file mtime); same session, not back-dated

model.name: claude-opus-5[1m]

issues_detected.description: keywords holds only four broad terms (health, biomarkers, bridge2ai, voice), below the >=5 searchability threshold and carrying none of the disease cohorts, acoustic modalities, methods or platform terms the record itself describes at length
issues_detected.recommendation: Add cohort, modality, method and platform keywords drawn from the record's own content (voice disorders, Parkinson's disease, depression, spectrogram, MFCC, phonetic posteriorgram, speech articulatory coding, PhysioNet, BIDS)

issues_detected.description: A cluster of dedicated slots is empty while the information they exist to carry is present in prose elsewhere: software_and_tools (tools named in preprocessing_strategies and external_resources), download_url (access route in page and raw_data_sources.access_details), is_tabular (TSV phenotype tables described throughout), resources / file_collections (per-file listing folded into distribution_formats.notes), parent_datasets (version lineage expressed only through related_datasets)
issues_detected.recommendation: Populate the typed slots so the facts are machine-readable rather than recoverable only by reading free text; the content to fill them is already in the record

issues_detected.description: confidential_elements_present is false ('no data protected by legal privilege or doctor-patient confidentiality') while regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level is 'restricted' and the release sits behind a signed access agreement; the two statements answer different questions but are not reconciled on either field
issues_detected.recommendation: Note on confidential_elements that the false value refers to legally privileged content only, and that access restriction derives from re-identification risk rather than privilege

issues_detected.description: data_protection_impacts states that no analysis of the impact of the dataset on data subjects has been conducted, in the same entry that reports a team of ethicists selecting fields for removal and a published memorandum justifying controlled access to raw voice; participant_privacy.reidentification_risk is itself a substantive risk assessment
issues_detected.recommendation: Distinguish the absence of a formal DPIA artefact from the risk analysis the record demonstrably contains, or point data_protection_impacts at participant_privacy

issues_detected.description: collection_timeframes reports collection over twelve months, taken from the healthsheet, while the same entry and version_access describe participants accruing across releases from November 2024 to May 2026 (306, then 136, then 391)
issues_detected.recommendation: Attribute the twelve-month figure to the release it describes, or replace it with per-release collection windows

issues_detected.description: notes states the adult protocol records 22 acoustic tasks and then enumerates 20 across the three groups (3 non-voice/non-speech, 5 voice/non-speech, 12 speech); the trailing clause about cohort-specific tasks does not say the list is partial
issues_detected.recommendation: Either complete the enumeration or mark it explicitly as the tasks common to all cohorts

issues_detected.description: content_warnings warns that free-speech transcription may contain offensive or distressing content, then states in the same entry that free-speech-derived dense features and transcripts were removed from the release; the warning therefore applies to the controlled-access raw audio route rather than to the published files, which is left implicit
issues_detected.recommendation: Scope the warning explicitly to the controlled-access raw audio distribution

issues_detected.description: ethical_reviews documents the reviewing organisation and the observational study design but says nothing about conflicts of interest, which the sub-element names alongside review documentation
issues_detected.recommendation: Record a conflict-of-interest statement, including its absence in the sources, rather than leaving the question unaddressed

semantic_insights: DOI 10.13026/8xbn-nq66 carries the PhysioNet prefix, matches the version named in title, version, page and citation, and is distinguished from the version-independent concept DOI 10.13026/37yb-1t42, which is carried in version_access.latest_version_doi and in an is_version_of relation rather than conflated with it

Every secondary identifier is well formed and its registrar is plausible: 10.13026/h995-bt35 and 10.13026/k81f-qr68 (PhysioNet), 10.57764/qb6h-em84 (Health Data Nexus), 10.21437/Interspeech.2024-1926 (ISCA), 10.5281/zenodo.12760724 (Zenodo), and RRID:SCR_007345 for PhysioNet in the citation

The NIH award is recorded in valid forms: core OT2OD032720 with the program title, the supplement 3OT2OD032720-01S1 credited on the PhysioNet releases, and 3OT2OD032720-01S3 with RePORTER application 11376382, principal investigator, award amount and project period
Participant arithmetic closes across three fields: collection_timeframes reports 306 + 136 + 391 accruing to the 833 in instances.counts and in the description

Temporal ordering is coherent throughout: releases run November 2024, 17 January 2025, 16 April 2025, 18 August 2025, 16 December 2025, 1 May 2026, and issued (2026-05-01) matches the 3.1.0 date in distribution_dates and the version in page

De-identification is appropriate and candid for biometric voice data: HIPAA Safe Harbor plus removal of indirect identifiers, free-speech-derived features and all raw audio, with the explicit admission that k-anonymity with k of two or more is not achieved and that voice can never be fully de-identified, which is stated as the reason raw audio is withheld

The two access tiers are held apart wherever they matter: registered access to features on PhysioNet and controlled access to raw audio through the Data Access Compliance Office and Synapse each carry their own agreement, review process, retention rule and contact

Preprocessing is documented at reproduction level: 16 kHz monaural conversion with a Butterworth anti-aliasing filter, a 25 ms window with 10 ms hop and 400-point FFT, 60 mel bins, 60 MFCCs, sparc at 50 Hz over six articulators, ppgs over 40 phonemes at 100 Hz, with b2aiprep pinned to v3.0.0

Source conflicts are retained rather than silently resolved: purposes[0] carries both the 10,000-voice project target and the 30,000-participant IRB protocol figure, with source_caveats naming the equal-ranked disagreement, and the PhysioNet per-feature counts are preferred over the documentation's 61,937 recording total with the reason stated
known_biases uses four distinct taxonomy values (selection, representation, measurement, annotation) with mitigations, rather than one catch-all narrative entry

human_subjects.evidence: description: '833 adult participants recruited at five sites in North America and selected for conditions that manifest in the voice waveform'; collection_mechanisms describes tablet-based collection from participants with a trained research assistant present

governance_restrictions.evidence: regulatory_restrictions.hipaa_compliant: compliant; confidentiality_level: restricted; other_compliance names a Certificate of Confidentiality and NIH STRIDES HIPAA agreements

datasets_shared_available_for_reuse.evidence: distribution_formats lists Parquet, TSV and JSON with file names; page: https://physionet.org/content/b2ai-voice/3.1.0/; license_and_use_terms.data_use_permission: general_research_use; third_party_sharing.is_shared: true

software_tools_produced.evidence: external_resources references https://github.com/sensein/b2aiprep (Apache-2.0), https://github.com/sensein/senselab and https://github.com/eipm/bridge2ai-redcap (MIT); purposes[2] names new bioinformatics standards for voice data as a deliverable

data_collection_identified_and_shared.evidence: acquisition_methods and collection_mechanisms are populated with instruments and settings, and the datasets-shared condition above is met

publication_identified_and_shared.evidence: citation gives a full PhysioNet citation with DOI; related_datasets carries two is_documented_by entries (doi:10.21437/Interspeech.2024-1926, doi:10.5281/zenodo.12760724)

elements.name: Dataset Discovery and Identification
elements.description: Can a user or system discover and uniquely identify this dataset?

sub_elements.name: Persistent Identifier (DOI, RRID, or URI)
sub_elements.evidence: id: doi:10.13026/8xbn-nq66; doi: 10.13026/8xbn-nq66; version_access.latest_version_doi: doi:10.13026/37yb-1t42; citation carries RRID:SCR_007345
sub_elements.quality_note: PhysioNet prefix valid and plausible. The version DOI and the concept DOI are separated deliberately, with source_caveats explaining which is the record's referent.

sub_elements.name: Dataset Title and Description Completeness
sub_elements.evidence: title: 'Bridge2AI-Voice: An ethically-sourced, diverse voice dataset linked to health information'; description ~1,700 chars naming 833 participants, five sites, the five cohort categories, the feature families released as Parquet and the withholding of raw audio
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific, quantified and semantically appropriate for a feature-only clinical voice release; it states what is not in the release as clearly as what is.

sub_elements.name: Keywords or Tags for Searchability
sub_elements.evidence: keywords: [health, biomarkers, bridge2ai, voice]
sub_elements.quality_note: Four broad terms, below the >=5 threshold, with no cohort, modality, method or platform term despite the record describing all of them in detail.

sub_elements.name: Landing Page and Resources (page, hierarchical resources)
sub_elements.evidence: page: https://physionet.org/content/b2ai-voice/3.1.0/; external_resources lists documentation at https://docs.b2ai-voice.org/ and the controlled-access route at https://www.synapse.org/Synapse:syn72370534/
sub_elements.quality_note: Version-pinned landing page on the publishing platform. The 'and/or' is met by the page alone; no resources or file_collections structure is present, so the per-file listing survives only as prose in distribution_formats.notes.

sub_elements.name: Hierarchical Structure (parent datasets, relationships)
sub_elements.evidence: related_datasets: six entries typed is_supplemented_by (pediatric doi:10.13026/h995-bt35), is_new_version_of (v3.0.0 and the Health Data Nexus v1.0), is_version_of (concept DOI) and is_documented_by (protocol paper, REDCap dictionary)
sub_elements.quality_note: Version lineage, companion dataset and documenting publications each carry a typed relation and a resolvable identifier; parent_datasets is unused but the same lineage is expressed here.

elements.name: Dataset Access and Retrieval
elements.description: Can the dataset and its associated resources be located, accessed, and downloaded?

sub_elements.name: Access Policy and IP Restrictions Defined
sub_elements.evidence: license_and_use_terms.license_terms: Bridge2AI Voice Registered Access License, credentialed PhysioNet users signing the agreement, duplication for the project permitted, sale forbidden, Fort Lauderdale Agreement respected; data_use_permission: general_research_use; ip_restrictions.restrictions covers copyright, downstream IP and the no-blocking condition
sub_elements.quality_note: Access tier, permitted acts, forbidden acts and IP position are each stated, and the licence named in license matches license_and_use_terms with no tier drift.

sub_elements.name: Regulatory Restrictions and Confidentiality Level Specified
sub_elements.evidence: regulatory_restrictions: hipaa_compliant: compliant; confidentiality_level: restricted; no export controls; other_compliance names a Certificate of Confidentiality and NIH STRIDES pre-negotiated HIPAA agreements
sub_elements.quality_note: Compliance status, sensitivity classification and the specific legal instruments are all present; the tension with confidential_elements_present=false is flagged separately.

sub_elements.name: Download URL or Platform Link Available
sub_elements.evidence: page: https://physionet.org/content/b2ai-voice/3.1.0/; raw_data_sources.access_details: Data Access Request Form, Data Use Agreement, review by DACO@b2ai-voice.org, Data Transfer and Use Agreement, delivery through https://www.synapse.org/Synapse:syn72370534/; data_governance.access_review_process repeats the steps
sub_elements.quality_note: Both routes are actionable end to end. The dedicated download_url slot is empty, so the access path is recoverable only from page and prose.

sub_elements.name: Distribution Formats and File Types Specified
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_formats: Apache Parquet (nine named feature files plus per-recording metadata), Tab-separated values (static_features.tsv, audio_quality_metrics.tsv, six phenotype folders), JSON (a data dictionary per file with the same stem)
sub_elements.quality_note: Formats are named with the actual files that carry them; no MIME types are given, which is the only gap.

sub_elements.name: Related Datasets and External Resources Linked
sub_elements.evidence: related_datasets: six typed entries with DOIs; external_resources: six entries with repository URLs and licences (bridge2ai-redcap MIT, b2aiprep Apache-2.0, senselab, bridge2ai-docs MIT, Synapse controlled access, FHIR profiles)
sub_elements.quality_note: Each external resource states what it is for and, where applicable, its licence and access condition; the FHIR entry honestly records that the bundle does not give the repository URL.

elements.name: Data Reuse and Interoperability
elements.description: Is sufficient information provided to reuse and integrate the dataset with others?

sub_elements.name: License Terms Allow Reuse
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: distribution_formats populated with Parquet, TSV and JSON; page resolves to the PhysioNet 3.1.0 record; third_party_sharing.is_shared: true
sub_elements.evidence: license: Bridge2AI Voice Registered Access License; license_and_use_terms.data_use_permission: general_research_use; 'no fees associated with these restrictions'
sub_elements.quality_note: Reuse is permitted for general research under a signed registered-access agreement, with the boundaries (no sale, no IP blocking) stated rather than implied.

sub_elements.name: Data Formats Are Standardized (encoding, format)
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: distribution_formats populated; page resolves to the PhysioNet 3.1.0 record; third_party_sharing.is_shared: true
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_formats: Apache Parquet, tab-separated values, JSON data dictionaries; raw_data_format: 'WAV audio, converted to monaural and resampled to 16 kHz'
sub_elements.quality_note: All open, widely supported formats, with the raw substrate's format and sampling rate also recorded; character encoding is not stated.

sub_elements.name: Schema or Ontology Conformance Stated
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: distribution_formats populated; page resolves to the PhysioNet 3.1.0 record; third_party_sharing.is_shared: true
sub_elements.evidence: conforms_to: 'Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) v1.9.0, applied to the audio dataset layout and the phenotype folder organization rather than to the Parquet feature files'; conforms_to_standard: [BIDS]; conforms_to_schema: https://w3id.org/bridge2ai/data-sheets-schema; instances carry B2AI_TOPIC and B2AI_SUBSTRATE CURIEs
sub_elements.quality_note: A versioned community standard with an explicit statement of which part of the release it governs, which is more useful than a bare conformance claim; ontology CURIEs are used for topic and substrate.

sub_elements.name: Variable Metadata with Identifiers Defined
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: distribution_formats populated; page resolves to the PhysioNet 3.1.0 record; third_party_sharing.is_shared: true
sub_elements.evidence: variables: thirteen entries; participant_id and session_id carry is_identifier: true with the linkage rule between feature records and phenotype rows; feature variables carry derivation, measurement_technique, unit and minimum_value / maximum_value (pitch 80-500, sparc_pitch 50-550 Hz) and quality_notes on absence
sub_elements.quality_note: Identifiers are marked and their join semantics explained; source_caveats states honestly that the list covers the shared identifying and dense-feature columns rather than every released column.

sub_elements.name: Use Guidance Provided (intended, prohibited uses)
sub_elements.evidence: intended_uses: three research categories with examples and usage_notes on constructing splits; discouraged_uses: hiring, insurance and surveillance, plus uses assuming representativeness; prohibited_uses: five entries covering re-identification, harm and stigmatisation, IP blocking and sale, contacting subjects, and onward disclosure
sub_elements.quality_note: All three registers are populated with reasons rather than bare prohibitions, and the discouraged uses connect back to the documented skews.

elements.name: Ethical Use and Privacy Safeguards
elements.description: Does the dataset provide clear information about consent, privacy, and ethical oversight?

sub_elements.name: IRB or Ethics Review and Data Protection Impact
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: description: '833 adult participants recruited at five sites in North America'; collection_mechanisms describes tablet-based collection from participants; regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level: restricted
sub_elements.evidence: human_subject_research.irb_approval: University of South Florida IRB with US sites under single IRB and separate Canadian REB approvals; ethical_reviews names the reviewing organisation and records that the study is observational with no data monitoring committee; data_governance.committee_name: Data Access Compliance Office (DACO) with contact DACO@b2ai-voice.org; data_protection_impacts records that no formal impact analysis was conducted
sub_elements.quality_note: IRB of record, the sIRB arrangement, the Canadian exception, the governance committee and its contact are all present, and the absence of a formal DPIA is stated rather than left blank.

sub_elements.name: Deidentification Method Described
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: description names adult participants and clinical cohorts; collection_mechanisms describes participant recruitment; regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level: restricted
sub_elements.evidence: is_deidentified.method: 'HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification, removal of selected indirect identifiers and highly sensitive non-identifying elements, and withholding of all raw audio'; identifiers_removed enumerates the Safe Harbor set plus narrative text and transcripts; deidentification_details records date rebasing, geographic generalisation and that k-anonymity with k of two or more is not achieved
sub_elements.quality_note: A named standard method, an enumerated removal list and an honest statement of its residual limits, which is the appropriate combination for biometric voice data.

sub_elements.name: Privacy Protections and Re-identification Risk Assessment
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: description names adult participants and clinical cohorts; collection_mechanisms describes participant recruitment; regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level: restricted
sub_elements.evidence: participant_privacy.reidentification_risk: 'a participant's voice cannot be fully de-identified and could in principle be recognized ... raw audio is therefore withheld'; privacy_techniques describes the HIPAA-compliant STRIDES-hosted database and federated learning with only model updates leaving each institution; data_linkage explains EHR access and local participant keys
sub_elements.quality_note: The risk assessment is explicit and is tied to the mitigation it motivates, and the protections are architectural rather than declarative.

sub_elements.name: Informed Consent Obtained from Participants
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: description names adult participants and clinical cohorts; collection_mechanisms describes participant recruitment; regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level: restricted
sub_elements.evidence: informed_consent: consent_obtained true; consent_type paper, in-app, REDCap or recorded video; consent_documentation with five-year retention; consent_scope covering EHR access and tiered sharing; withdrawal_mechanism stating that data collected before withdrawal cannot be removed once the session completes; collection_consents, collection_notifications and consent_revocations repeat the terms from the participant's side
sub_elements.quality_note: Consent modality, storage, scope and the exact limit of withdrawal are all specified, including the uncomfortable part that completed recordings cannot be withdrawn.

sub_elements.name: Vulnerable Populations and Compensation Documented
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: description names adult participants and clinical cohorts; collection_mechanisms describes participant recruitment; regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level: restricted
sub_elements.evidence: at_risk_populations.at_risk_groups_included: true, with cohorts including mild cognitive impairment, Alzheimer's disease and psychiatric diagnoses, the note that mood and psychiatric questions can trigger negative emotions, and the 18-and-over restriction; participant_compensation: electronic gift cards, 40 USD under 90 minutes, 80 USD over, maximum three sessions and 120 USD
sub_elements.quality_note: The at-risk groups are named with the specific discomfort the protocol anticipates, and compensation is exact with its cap; the pediatric exclusion is stated rather than assumed.

elements.name: Data Composition and Structure
elements.description: Can the dataset's structure, modality, and population be understood from metadata?

sub_elements.name: Cohort or Subpopulations Characteristics Described
sub_elements.evidence: subpopulations: two entries, one for the disease cohort categories assigned at enrollment from a clinical diagnosis, one for the demographic sub-populations recorded in the demographics table (age, gender, sex, ethnicity, socioeconomic status), each with a distribution statement noting the skew and the absence of pediatric participants
sub_elements.quality_note: Both the clinical and the demographic axis are described, and each carries the honest distribution caveat rather than only the definition.

sub_elements.name: Number of Instances or Samples Reported
sub_elements.evidence: instances[0].counts: 833 study participants; instances[1].notes gives eight per-feature record counts for v3.1.0 (29,278 spectrogram / mel / MFCC, 32,522 torchaudio pitch, 28,640 sparc ema, 31,855 sparc loudness, 31,872 sparc periodicity and pitch, 29,289 ppgs)
sub_elements.quality_note: Counts are precise, the reason they differ between feature files is given, and the record declines to state a single recording total the preferred source does not report, explaining that choice in source_caveats.

sub_elements.name: Variable-Level Metadata and Tabular Flag
sub_elements.evidence: variables: thirteen entries with variable_name, data_type, is_identifier, derivation, measurement_technique, unit, value ranges and quality_notes; distribution_formats records a JSON data dictionary accompanying every file
sub_elements.quality_note: Column-level documentation is detailed enough to reconstruct the dense feature tensors; the is_tabular flag is not set even though the TSV phenotype and static-feature tables are described throughout.

sub_elements.name: Data Topics or Conditions Represented
sub_elements.evidence: instances[0].data_topic: B2AI_TOPIC:4 with label_description naming voice disorders, neurological and neurodegenerative disorders, mood and psychiatric disorders, respiratory disorders and controls; instances[1].data_substrate: B2AI_SUBSTRATE:30 and data_topic: B2AI_TOPIC:36
sub_elements.quality_note: Conditions are given both as ontology CURIEs and as readable cohort names, with the clinician-assignment rule stated.

sub_elements.name: Data Quality Issues and Anomalies Documented
sub_elements.evidence: anomalies: five entries covering site configuration drift, protocol change, headset distance and noise artifacts, varying diagnostic practice, feature-generation failures and the broken Parquet files of v3.0.0; sampling_strategies records is_random false, is_representative false with why_not_representative; missing_data_documentation gives patterns, causes and the no-imputation handling strategy with a released missingness table
sub_elements.quality_note: The failure modes are specific and traceable to the counts they explain, and the record states that no cleaning was performed and describes the audit protocol applied instead.

elements.name: Data Provenance and Version Tracking
elements.description: Can a user determine dataset versions, update history, and provenance?

sub_elements.name: Dataset Version Number Provided
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: distribution_formats populated; page resolves to the PhysioNet 3.1.0 record; third_party_sharing.is_shared: true
sub_elements.evidence: version: '3.1.0'; the same version appears in title context, page (.../3.1.0/), citation and the counts attributed to v3.1.0
sub_elements.quality_note: The version is stated once and used consistently everywhere the record makes a version-specific claim.

sub_elements.name: Version Access Methods Documented
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: distribution_formats populated; page resolves to the PhysioNet 3.1.0 record; third_party_sharing.is_shared: true
sub_elements.evidence: version_access.versions_available lists v1.0 on the Health Data Nexus and 1.1, 2.0.0, 2.0.1, 3.0.0, 3.1.0 on PhysioNet; version_details states that older versions remain hosted by default with a unique DOI each, subject to the publisher's right to withdraw; latest_version_doi: doi:10.13026/37yb-1t42
sub_elements.quality_note: How to reach an older version, what guarantees it carries and how to resolve the latest are all answered.

sub_elements.name: Change Descriptions and Errata Provided
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: distribution_formats populated; page resolves to the PhysioNet 3.1.0 record; third_party_sharing.is_shared: true
sub_elements.evidence: errata: four entries (v2.0.0 spectrogram reprocessing and free-speech removal, v2.0.1 authorship correction, v3.1.0 broken Parquet fix with back-filled diagnoses and renamed gold-standard variables, and the statement that no formal erratum is published beyond the online changelog); version_access.version_details carries a per-version change narrative
sub_elements.quality_note: Corrections are attributed to the version that made them, including the authorship error, and the absence of a formal erratum channel is stated rather than implied.

sub_elements.name: Update Schedule or Frequency Indicated
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: distribution_formats populated; page resolves to the PhysioNet 3.1.0 record; third_party_sharing.is_shared: true
sub_elements.evidence: updates.frequency: 'Semi-annual (twice a year)'; update_details describes release as new platform versions, notification through platform news items, and the kinds of change updates have carried
sub_elements.quality_note: A stated cadence with a notification mechanism, and the release dates in distribution_dates are consistent with roughly twice-yearly publication.

sub_elements.name: Provenance and Source Derivation Documented
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: distribution_formats populated; page resolves to the PhysioNet 3.1.0 record; third_party_sharing.is_shared: true
sub_elements.evidence: was_derived_from: raw voice, speech, breathing and cough audio plus REDCap questionnaire and clinical exports; raw_data_sources gives source_description, source_type, raw_data_format and the controlled-access route to the withheld audio; preprocessing_strategies traces waveform to Parquet through b2aiprep v3.0.0 and senselab
sub_elements.quality_note: The chain from instrument to released artefact is unbroken and the tool that produced this specific release is version-pinned; no separate release_notes slot is used, but version_details serves that role.

elements.name: Scientific Motivation and Funding Transparency
elements.description: Does the metadata clearly state why the dataset exists and who funded it?

sub_elements.name: Motivation or Purpose for Dataset Creation
sub_elements.evidence: purposes: four entries covering the flagship ethically sourced voice dataset, clinically applicable model development, new acoustic and interoperability standards with diversity benchmarks, and ethical, legal and governance norms for voice data; addressing_gaps: four entries on small prior samples, absent measurement standards, private industry data and limited open voice datasets
sub_elements.quality_note: Motivation and the gap it addresses are stated separately and specifically, and purposes[0] preserves the disagreement between the 10,000-voice target and the 30,000-participant protocol figure with its source rationale.

sub_elements.name: Primary Research Objectives or Tasks
sub_elements.evidence: tasks: detection and classification of disease from voice across vocal, neurological, psychiatric and respiratory labels; and pretraining, fine-tuning, benchmarking and validation of models on voice, speech and respiratory audio features
sub_elements.quality_note: Both a clinical and a machine-learning objective, each naming the label families and modalities they operate on.

sub_elements.name: Funding Sources and Mechanisms Listed
sub_elements.evidence: funders.grantor: National Institutes of Health Common Fund, with the Bridge2AI program named and the award title quoted in full
sub_elements.quality_note: Agency, programme and mechanism (an OT2 other-transaction award under the Common Fund) are all identifiable.

sub_elements.name: Grant IDs or Award Numbers Present
sub_elements.evidence: funders.notes: award OT2OD032720; PhysioNet releases credit 3OT2OD032720-01S1; RePORTER application 11376382 under 3OT2OD032720-01S3 with principal investigator, institution, FY2025 amount 4,660,942 and a project period of 1 September 2022 to 30 November 2026
sub_elements.quality_note: The core award and both supplement forms follow valid NIH patterns (OT2 activity code, OD institute, six digits, -01S suffixes), and the record distinguishes which source credits which form.

sub_elements.name: Creators and Acknowledgements Documented
sub_elements.evidence: creators: fifteen named principal investigators with affiliations, and credit_roles or module notes for most (co-PIs, data acquisition, software and IT, ethics module, per-cohort lead investigators, genomic collection under separate Canadian approval); maintainers names PhysioNet, the consortium and the Health Data Nexus host
sub_elements.quality_note: Roles are attributed rather than a flat author list, and source_caveats states plainly that the release names 120 authors while the record lists the co-PIs and cohort leads.

elements.name: Technical Transparency (Data Collection and Processing)
elements.description: Can data collection and processing steps be replicated or understood?

sub_elements.name: Collection Mechanisms and Settings Described
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: acquisition_methods and collection_mechanisms are populated, and the datasets-shared condition is met (distribution_formats, page, third_party_sharing.is_shared: true)
sub_elements.evidence: collection_mechanisms: custom tablet application sending over HTTPS to HIPAA-compliant NIH STRIDES cloud storage; iPad 9th/10th generation and iPad Air 5th generation with an Avid AE-36 head-mounted microphone through an Apple dongle, distinct devices per site; instruments and dictionary maintained in REDCap; direct_collection and data_collectors describe the in-clinic setting and who was present
sub_elements.quality_note: Hardware, transport, storage and the human setting are each named at a level that lets a reader reproduce the configuration or explain a device-related artifact.

sub_elements.name: Data Acquisition Methods Listed
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: acquisition_methods and collection_mechanisms are populated, and the datasets-shared condition is met
sub_elements.evidence: acquisition_methods: directly observed and self-reported for acoustic tasks and questionnaires; validated/verified for clinician-confirmed diagnoses against laryngoscopy, stroboscopy, brain CT and MRI and spirometry with flow-volume loops; inferred/derived for all released features and ASR transcriptions; raw_data_sources records the WAV substrate and its 16 kHz monaural conversion
sub_elements.quality_note: The three acquisition modes are separated with the correct boolean flags and each is tied to the specific gold standard or toolchain that produced it.

sub_elements.name: Preprocessing, Cleaning, Labeling, and Annotation Quality
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: external_resources references https://github.com/sensein/b2aiprep and https://github.com/sensein/senselab; purposes[2] names new bioinformatics standards for voice data as a dataset output
sub_elements.evidence: preprocessing_strategies: eight entries with STFT window 25 ms, hop 10 ms, 400-point FFT, 60 mel bins, 60 MFCCs, sparc at 50 Hz over six articulators, ppgs over 40 phonemes at 100 Hz, BIDS v1.9.0 restructuring, and b2aiprep v3.0.0; cleaning_strategies records that no cleaning was performed and describes the audit protocol instead; labeling_strategies gives per-cohort gold standards with annotations_per_item: 1; annotation_analyses states no inter-annotator agreement is computable with one labeler; machine_annotation_tools names OpenAI Whisper Large as unaudited
sub_elements.quality_note: Reproduction-level parameters throughout, and the annotation limits are disclosed rather than glossed; imputation_protocols is unused but missing_data_documentation states that no imputation is performed.

sub_elements.name: Software and Tools Documented
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: external_resources references code repositories under Apache-2.0 and MIT; purposes[2] names standards and tooling as a dataset output
sub_elements.evidence: b2aiprep v3.0.0 and senselab in preprocessing_strategies with repositories https://github.com/sensein/b2aiprep (Apache-2.0) and https://github.com/sensein/senselab in external_resources; openSMILE, Praat, parselmouth, torchaudio, sparc and ppgs named against the features they produce; Whisper Large in machine_annotation_tools; extension_mechanism.contribution_url points at b2aiprep
sub_elements.quality_note: Every tool is bound to the artefact it produced and the release-generating library is version-pinned; the dedicated software_and_tools slot is empty, so this is recoverable only across four other slots.

elements.name: Dataset Evaluation and Limitations Disclosure
elements.description: Does the metadata communicate known risks, biases, or dataset limitations?

sub_elements.name: Known Limitations Documented
sub_elements.evidence: known_limitations: six typed entries covering English-only fluency, non-representativeness across five North American sites, the features-only scope with raw audio withheld, the absence of imaging and genomic modalities, temporal drift over a twelve-month protocol-changing collection, and single-labeler methodology
sub_elements.quality_note: Each limitation carries a type and most carry a mitigation or a scope_impact, so the reader learns both the constraint and what to do about it.

sub_elements.name: Biases Categorized Using Standard Taxonomy (RAI-aligned)
sub_elements.evidence: known_biases: selection_bias (recruitment at expert clinics, distance and trust effects), representation_bias (unequal cohort distribution and demographic skew, with affected_subsets), measurement_bias (per-site devices and configurations, headset distance, noise), annotation_bias (single clinician, EHR or prescription-derived labels, varying practice); future_use_impacts adds three anticipated downstream effects
sub_elements.quality_note: Four distinct enum values with mechanism, affected subsets and mitigation, rather than one undifferentiated fairness paragraph.

sub_elements.name: Data Anomalies and Quality Issues Noted
sub_elements.evidence: anomalies: five entries including per-site configuration differences, protocol change during collection, microphone distance and noise artifacts, varying diagnostic practice and under-reported questionnaire responses, feature-generation failures explaining the differing record counts, and the broken v3.0.0 Parquet files
sub_elements.quality_note: The anomalies are specific and each one explains an observable property of the released files, including the count discrepancy documented in instances.

sub_elements.name: Sensitive Content and Warnings Provided
sub_elements.evidence: sensitive_elements: race and ethnic origin, sexual orientation, socioeconomic and health information including psychiatric and respiratory instruments, with a note on the REDCap-encoded fields removed before release; content_warnings: free-speech transcription content and psychiatric questionnaire subject matter, with the removals applied; confidential_elements records no legally privileged content
sub_elements.quality_note: Sensitivity is enumerated by category and paired with what was removed; the warning's scope relative to the feature-only release is the one point left implicit.

sub_elements.name: Ethical Review Details Including Conflicts
sub_elements.evidence: ethical_reviews: University of South Florida IRB, approval of the Data Acquisition protocol and of data sharing, subsites through the single IRB process, observational design, not a drug or device study, no data monitoring committee appointed
sub_elements.quality_note: Review body, scope of approval and study-design facts a reviewer would ask for are present; conflicts of interest are not addressed in any form, including as an absence.

sub_elements.name: Related Datasets with Typed Relationships
sub_elements.applicability_evidence: distribution_formats populated; page resolves to the PhysioNet 3.1.0 record; third_party_sharing.is_shared: true
sub_elements.evidence: related_datasets: is_supplemented_by the pediatric dataset with its cohort, site, ethics approval and assent procedure; is_new_version_of v3.0.0 and of the Health Data Nexus v1.0; is_version_of the concept DOI; is_documented_by the Interspeech protocol paper and the Zenodo REDCap dictionary
sub_elements.quality_note: Six typed relations, each with a resolvable DOI and a description that says why the relation holds; the pediatric companion is kept as a related dataset rather than absorbed into this record's own distribution.

strengths: Ethics is complete and internally coherent across all five sub-elements: the University of South Florida IRB of record with the single-IRB arrangement and separate Canadian approvals, HIPAA Safe Harbor with an enumerated removal list, a candid re-identification statement that admits k-anonymity with k of two or more is not achieved, consent with its documentation, scope and the exact limit of withdrawal, and compensation with amounts and a cap.

The two access tiers never blur. Registered access to features on PhysioNet and controlled access to raw audio through the Data Access Compliance Office and Synapse each carry their own agreement, review process, retention rule and contact, and the licence named in license matches license_and_use_terms with no tier drift.

Identifier discipline is unusually careful: the version DOI is the record's id, the concept DOI sits in version_access.latest_version_doi and in an is_version_of relation, and source_caveats explains the choice. Every secondary DOI across PhysioNet, Health Data Nexus, ISCA and Zenodo is well formed, and the NIH award appears in three valid forms.

Preprocessing is documented at reproduction level, from the 16 kHz monaural conversion and Butterworth filter through window, hop and FFT sizes to the sparc and ppgs frame rates, with each tool bound to the artefact it produced and b2aiprep pinned to v3.0.0 for this release.

Counts close and are honestly bounded: 306 plus 136 plus 391 accrue to the 833 participants stated in the description and in instances, the eight per-feature record counts are given with the reason they differ, and the record declines to compute a recording total its preferred source never states.

Disagreement between sources is preserved rather than resolved by fiat. The 10,000-voice target and the 30,000-participant protocol figure are both recorded with the rank rationale, and the PhysioNet counts are preferred over the documentation's with the reason given.
weaknesses: keywords carries four broad terms and none of the cohort, modality, method or platform vocabulary the record itself supplies, which is the single scored failure and the one that most directly limits discovery.

Several typed slots that exist for exactly the facts this record holds are left empty, so the facts survive only as prose: software_and_tools, download_url, is_tabular, file_collections or resources, and parent_datasets. A consumer parsing the schema rather than reading the text loses them.

confidential_elements_present is false while confidentiality_level is restricted, and data_protection_impacts reports that no impact analysis was conducted in the same entry that describes ethicist-led field selection and a published ethics memorandum. Both are defensible readings but neither is reconciled on the field where a reader meets it.

The twelve-month collection window taken from the healthsheet sits beside a release history spanning November 2024 to May 2026 with participants added at each release, with no note attributing the figure to the release it describes.

notes announces 22 acoustic tasks and enumerates 20, and content_warnings warns about free-speech content in the same entry that reports free-speech-derived features and transcripts were removed from the release, leaving the warning's true scope implicit.
ethical_reviews says nothing about conflicts of interest, not even to record that the sources do not address them.
recommendations: Expand keywords to at least eight terms drawn from the record's own content: voice disorders, Parkinson's disease, depression, spectrogram, MFCC, phonetic posteriorgram, speech articulatory coding, PhysioNet, BIDS.

Populate software_and_tools from the tools already named in preprocessing_strategies and external_resources, set download_url to the PhysioNet content URL, set is_tabular, and express the per-file listing currently in distribution_formats.notes as file_collections or resources entries.

Add a clause to confidential_elements stating that the false value refers to legally privileged content only, and point data_protection_impacts at participant_privacy.reidentification_risk so the absence of a formal DPIA is not read as an absence of risk analysis.
Attribute the twelve-month collection figure to the release it describes, or replace it with per-release collection windows consistent with the version history.
Complete the task enumeration in notes or mark it as the tasks common to all cohorts, and scope the free-speech content warning explicitly to the controlled-access raw audio route.
Record a conflict-of-interest statement in ethical_reviews, including an explicit statement that the sources do not report one if that is the case.
